subject: DI03005061

body.en:
Definition and principle

Recycle returns part of a downstream stream to an upstream process point. Fresh feed F and recycle R form combined feed M. Recycle can improve overall fresh-feed utilization but does not by itself change the defined single-pass reactor conversion.

Balance method and important conditions

Draw a boundary around the reactor to calculate single-pass conversion and around the entire process for overall fresh-feed conversion. Internal recycle cancels from the overall balance. On the same mass/molar basis, recycle ratio is R/F and combined-feed ratio is M/F. With perfect separation and no purge of unreacted feed, overall conversion can approach complete use even with incomplete single-pass conversion; real process constraints still matter.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Downstream stream નો ભાગ upstream process point પર પાછો મોકલવાની operation Recycle છે. Fresh feed F તથા recycle R ભેગાં થઈ combined feed M બને છે. Recycle થી overall fresh-feed utilization વધારી શકાય છે, પણ single-pass conversion ની definition બદલાતી નથી.

Balance Method તથા જરૂરી Conditions

Single-pass conversion માટે reactor boundary અને overall conversion માટે આખા process ની boundary લો. Overall balance માં internal recycle cancel થાય છે. Same mass/molar basis પર recycle ratio R/F અને combined-feed ratio M/F છે. Perfect separation તથા unreacted feed નો purge ન હોય ત્યારે incomplete single-pass conversion છતાં overall fresh feed complete utilize થઈ શકે છે; real constraints અલગથી લાગુ પડે છે.

સમીકરણો / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition and principle

A purge deliberately withdraws part of a recycle stream to prevent accumulation of inerts or unwanted species. An ideal splitter creates purge and recycle streams with identical composition; it does not selectively remove inerts.

Balance method and important conditions

Define purge fraction as P/(P+R) at the specified splitter; P/R is a different ratio and must not be substituted silently. At steady state, an inert entering with fresh feed must leave through purge or another specified outlet. No-purge steady operation is impossible when a nonreacting inert enters and has no other exit. Purging also loses reactant.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Recycle માંથી stream નો ભાગ બહાર કાઢીને inerts અથવા unwanted species નું accumulation અટકાવવાની operation Purging છે. Ideal splitter માં purge તથા recycle ની composition સમાન છે; તે selectively inert દૂર કરતું separator નથી.

Balance Method તથા જરૂરી Conditions

ચોક્કસ splitter પર purge fraction P/(P+R) લો; P/R જુદો ratio છે. Steady state માં fresh feed સાથે આવતો inert purge અથવા બીજા specified outlet થી બહાર જવો જોઈએ. Nonreacting inert માટે બીજો exit ન હોય તો zero-purge steady operation શક્ય નથી. Purge સાથે reactant નો loss પણ થાય છે.

સમીકરણો / સંકેતો

body.en:
Definition and principle

A bypass diverts part of a stream around a process unit and recombines it downstream. It can control final composition or temperature without treating all the feed. The bypass branch retains the feed composition unless another operation is specified.

Balance method and important conditions

Balance the splitter, treating unit and final mixer separately. Bypass fraction is bypass amount divided by total feed at the splitter. A dryer/evaporator changes the treated-branch mass; do not assume equal inlet/outlet mass through it. Use a dry-solid balance where solvent is removed.

Equations / symbols
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Feed નો ભાગ unit ની બહારથી પસાર કરીને downstream ફરી ભેગો કરવાની operation Bypass છે. બધો feed treat કર્યા વગર final composition અથવા temperature control કરી શકાય છે. બીજી operation આપેલી ન હોય તો bypass composition feed જેટલી જ છે.

Balance Method તથા જરૂરી Conditions

Splitter, treating unit તથા final mixer અલગ balance કરો. Bypass fraction એટલે splitter ના total feed દીઠ bypass amount. Dryer/evaporator માં treated branch નો mass બદલાય છે; inlet તથા outlet mass સમાન ન માનો. Solvent remove થતું હોય ત્યાં dry-solid balance લો.

body.en:
Calculation workflow

Distinguish fresh and combined feed. Draw reactor and overall boundaries. Show purge split separately. Define R/F, P/(P+R), B/F with denominators. If a nonreacting inert enters, identify an exit at steady state. For bypass drying, do not conserve total wet mass across the dryer; conserve dry solid.

How to practise honestly

Rework the solved cases without seeing the answer, then compare equations, units and closure. Change one input at a time and recheck feasibility. These are study exercises, not laboratory readings.
body.gu:
Calculation Workflow

Fresh તથા combined feed અલગ કરો. Reactor તથા overall boundaries દોરો. Purge split અલગ બતાવો. R/F, P/(P+R), B/F માં denominator લખો. Nonreacting inert નો steady-state exit ઓળખો. Bypass dryer માં total wet mass નહીં, dry solid conserve કરો.

પ્રમાણિક Practice કેવી રીતે કરવી

પ્રથમ answer જોયા વગર solved cases ફરી કરો. પછી equations, units તથા closure સરખાવો. એક સમયે એક input બદલીને feasibility ફરી check કરો. આ study exercises છે, laboratory readings નથી.
